Basic Information

  • Full Project Title: Sustainable Elastomer Technologies (2 Positions)
  • Host Institution: University of Warwick
  • Programme: Net2Zero CDT (EPSRC and BBSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Negative Emission Technologies for Net Zero)
  • Partner: James Walker Group
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: 4 years
  • Start Date: October 2026
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: £21,805 per year (UKRI rate for 2026/27)
  • Eligibility: Check Net2Zero CDT page
  • Application Deadline: Rolling until filled

Project Description

This project focuses on developing sustainable elastomer materials for industrial applications such as seals and gaskets. The Net2Zero CDT is a collaboration across four leading UK universities.

How to Apply

Apply via the Net2Zero CDT / Warwick Engineering PhD application route.
